content.comment_body: Hello. When I press the button to select hardware (Ctrl+H), I encounter an error as shown in the attached image. I appreciate any assistance.
It seems either the project file or the related software may be corrupted. Could you compress the project file and upload the archive? This way, the community can help verify the file's integrity.
There may have been confusion. I was referring to the diagram file (.lsc), not the executable file.
The error occurs even without an open project when pressing (Ctrl+H).
The project file itself appears fine. Is your Java installation current? If it is, I recommend uninstalling and reinstalling [product_name] software.
I can confirm that the function works on my system without any errors. This project looks quite advanced. May I ask what your application is?

analysis.insight_summary: The issue centers on encountering an error when attempting to select hardware using a specific function in [product_name] software, regardless of whether a project is open. Troubleshooting focuses on verifying the integrity of the project file, updating relevant system dependencies such as Java, or reinstalling the software to resolve potential installation or file corruption issues. These steps directly impact users' ability to work with the application.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to select hardware within [product_name] software without errors, no matter the project state.
